newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Little hope of saving Russia Mars probe - official.
newsitem.headline: Little hope of saving Russia Mars probe - official.

text.p: Russian space experts are still trying to put a troubled space probe back on course for its mission to Mars but there is probably little they can do, the Russian Space Agency said.
"The specialists are still working...but it's probably too late," spokesman Vladimir Ananayev told Reuters.
Ananayev said it was too early to talk about abandoning the mission, but if the specialists could not do anything the probe would burn up in the atmosphere.
Ekho Moskvy radio quoted experts at the mission control centre as saying the probe was likely to burn up some time on Monday.
The six-tonne probe, which lifted off from Kazakhstan's Baikonur space centre on Saturday at 11.48 p.m. Moscow time (2048 GMT), was due to reach Mars on September 12 next year.
